# SMoRG's QoL

**Hear your quest progress:** *"Work, work."* when you finish an objective, *"Work complete."* when the quest is done. Prefer the Alliance? Switch to the Human worker (*"More work?"* / *"Job's done!"*).

On top of the quest sounds come a bunch of small quality-of-life tweaks, each one **individually toggleable**. Works in Retail, WoW Forever, Classic Era, Anniversary and Mists of Pandaria Classic.

## What's new in 1.9

- 💬 **Floating combat banter** — just for fun: **FIGHT** when combat starts, then **GG**, **PHEW CLOSE** or **NEXT TIME**, floating up near your character. Retail and WoW Forever.
- 📈 Up to six **floating reputation and skill gains** at once, so a quest that rewards five factions shows them all.
- ⭐ Fixed: the star on new WoW Forever quests in the objective tracker no longer grows over the whole screen when you accept a quest.

Combat banter is off by default; turn it on under **Reputation & XP** or with `/sqol fight`. See the [changelog](https://github.com/SMoRG75/SMoRGsQoL/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for the full release history.

## Features

**Quests**
- 🔊 **Quest sounds** — Peon or Human worker voice lines when you finish an objective or a whole quest.
- 🤖 **Quest automation** — accepts regular, daily and weekly quests and turns in completed ones. Never picks a reward for you and never hands in gold, currency or non-quest items.
- 📡 **Smart Quest Radar** — a quest icon and objective counts (e.g. `2/8 · 1/5`) above the nameplates of units you still need.
- ⭐ **New WoW Forever quests** — a blue star on quests that are new in WoW Forever, in quest giver lists, the quest text, the quest log, the objective tracker and on the world map.
- 🏷️ **Nameplate objective counts** — quest progress above relevant nameplates.
- 🧭 **Auto-track new quests** in the objective tracker.
- 🎨 **Colored quest progress** — counts like `3/10` go from red through yellow to green, in chat and in the quest tracker.
- 📖 **Adventure Recap** — a window with this session's quests, reputation, playtime and top faction.

**Character, reputation & XP**
- 🧾 **Item level and speed** on your player frame.
- 🎨 **Colored XP/reputation numbers**, plus percentage left on both bars and standing on the reputation bar.
- 🤝 **Auto-watch reputation** — switches to the faction you just gained reputation with.
- 🧠 **Reputation Memory** — returns to your preferred faction 10 seconds later.
- ✨ **Floating reputation gains** — `+25 Rep — Valarjar` near the screen center.
- 📈 **Floating skill gains** — `+1 Staves (18/20)` the same way when a profession or weapon skill goes up.
- 💬 **Floating combat banter** — **FIGHT**, **GG**, **PHEW CLOSE** or **NEXT TIME** near your character.
- ↕️ **Move the floating text** with the button in the options window or `/sqol movetext` — drag the bar, then click **Okay**. Retail and WoW Forever.

**Group**
- ⏱️ **Ready check countdown** and ⏳ **LFG queue pop countdown**.
- 👥 **Party member levels** on the party frames.
- 🙏 **Thank players who buff you** — the `/thank` emote in the open world, at most once every 5 minutes per player. WoW Forever.

**Interface**
- 🎯 **Target in unit tooltips** — who the unit is targeting, with a red `You` when it is you.
- 🎨 **Colorful unit tooltips**.
- 🔗 **Wowhead links** and the **Show web link** key binding.
- 🏹 **Range icon and distance** to your target on its nameplate.
- 🟦 **Square minimap** with a thin black border; addon minimap buttons follow the square edge.
- ✅ **Hide completed achievements** by default.
- 🖋️ **Custom damage text font** and 🖱️ **cursor shake highlight**.

## Classic clients

The quest sounds and most features work everywhere. A few need Retail-only parts of the UI and are simply left out of the options in the Classic clients: Smart Quest Radar, nameplate objective counts, auto-track, the range icon, the square minimap, combat banter and the colored counts in the quest tracker. Classic Era and Anniversary also have no achievements or group finder, so those two features are only in Mists of Pandaria Classic.

## Settings

Open the options window from:
- 🧩 a **LibDataBroker display** such as Bazooka or Titan Panel,
- 📋 the **addon compartment** menu by the minimap,
- 🗺️ the optional **minimap button** (`/sqol minimap`), or
- 💬 `/sqol config`.

**Esc → Options → AddOns → SMoRG's QoL** has a button that opens the same window, and every option has a chat command. Type `/sqol help` for the full list.

## Translations

The addon follows your game language: English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese. The voice lines are always in English.

⚠️ The translations have not been checked by native speakers yet. If something reads oddly, please suggest a better wording on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/smorgsqol) or [GitHub](https://github.com/SMoRG75/SMoRGsQoL/issues).

## Support

SMoRG's QoL is free and always will be. If you'd like to say thanks, you can sponsor it on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/SMoRG75). Bug reports and ideas are just as welcome on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/smorgsqol) or [GitHub](https://github.com/SMoRG75/SMoRGsQoL/issues).

# Changelog

## [1.9.0] - 2026-11-14

### Added

- **Floating combat banter** — just for fun: floating text near your character, where the reputation gains float, says **FIGHT** when combat starts, then **GG** when you win, **PHEW CLOSE** when combat ends while a living enemy is still targeted (you got away), or **NEXT TIME** when you die. Retail and WoW Forever only. Toggle under **Reputation & XP** or with `/sqol fight` (`gg`). Off by default.

### Changed

- **Floating reputation and skill gains** show up to six lines at once, instead of three. A quest that gives reputation with five factions now shows every gain. When even more arrive at once, the oldest line makes room.

### Fixed

- **Mark new WoW Forever quests**: when you accepted a new WoW Forever quest, the blue star in the objective tracker grew until it covered the whole screen. It now stays small.

## [1.8.0] - 2026-11-14

### Added

- **Square minimap** — makes the minimap square, with a thin black border in place of Blizzard's round frame. Minimap buttons from addons that use LibDBIcon line up along the square edge. In WoW Forever the day/night indicator moves into the top right corner. If Retail switches to its separate instance map, that map turns square too. Turning the option off brings the round minimap back right away. Retail and WoW Forever only. Toggle under **Interface** or with `/sqol squareminimap` (`sqm`). Off by default.

## [1.7.0] - 2026-11-08

### Added

- **Mark new WoW Forever quests** — a small blue star on the quest icon of quests that are new in WoW Forever (not in the original game): in the quest giver's quest list, next to the title of the quest text, on the quest buttons in the quest log and the objective tracker and on the world map's quest pins (quests you can pick up and quests in your log), whose tooltips also say *New in WoW Forever*. (The `!` above a quest giver in the game world is drawn by the game itself, so addons can't mark it.) New quests are recognized by their quest ID (80000 and up; the original quests are far below). WoW Forever only. Toggle under **Quests** or with `/sqol foreverquests` (`fq`). Off by default.

After updating, **restart the game** (a `/reload` is not enough), because this release adds a new file.

## [1.6.0] - 2026-11-08

### Added

- **Floating skill gains** — when a profession or weapon skill goes up, it floats up near the character the same way as reputation gains, in blue with the new level and cap, e.g. `+1 Staves (18/20)` (the cap shows where the client reports it: every skill in Classic and WoW Forever, professions in Retail). Toggle under **Reputation & XP** or with `/sqol skilltext` (`sk`); `/sqol skilltexttest` previews it. Off by default.

After updating, **restart the game** (a `/reload` is not enough), because this release adds a new file.

## [1.5.2] - 2026-11-07

### Fixed

- **Smart Quest Radar** and **nameplate objective counts** now show with nameplate addons that replace Blizzard's nameplates, such as Platynator. Before, they stayed hidden on those nameplates.
- The range icon and distance no longer overlap the unit's name on those nameplates.

## [1.5.1] - 2026-11-01

### Changed

- **Esc → Options → AddOns → SMoRG's QoL** now holds a single button that opens the options window, instead of a second copy of every option, so every route leads to the same window. Right-clicking the LibDataBroker launcher, the minimap button or the addon compartment entry now opens the window too, and the window no longer has a **Blizzard Settings** button.
- The options window is wider, so long labels such as **Quest automation override key** fit, and every section heading has an icon.

## [1.5.0] - 2026-10-27

### Added

- **Colorful unit tooltips** — players' names, specs, the tooltip border and the health bar in their class color (reaction colors for NPCs), the guild in green as `<Guild>`, the level in the difficulty color you know from the target frame, and Horde in red or Alliance in blue, with the health on the health bar (e.g. `18.8K / 23.8K (79%)`). Toggle under **Interface** or with `/sqol tooltipcolor` (`tc`). Off by default.
- **Quest automation** — accepts and turns in quests at quest givers, like Leatrix Plus' *Automate quests*, in every client. Separate options under **Quests** for regular, daily and weekly quests and for turn-ins (`/sqol questaccept`, `questdaily`, `questweekly`, `questturnin`), all off by default. Holding the override key (SHIFT, ALT, CONTROL or CMD, `/sqol questkey`) pauses it; with **Require override key for quest automation** (`/sqol questrequirekey`) quests are only automated while you hold it. Never picks between several rewards, never hands in money, currency or items that aren't quest items, skips quests shared by other players and quests that flag you for PvP, pauses in combat inside instances, and only clicks quest lines in gossip, never gossip options.
- **Wowhead links** — like Leatrix Plus' *Show Wowhead links*: a copyable Wowhead link for the quest in the quest log (on the world map in Retail and WoW Forever, in place of the quest log title in Classic) and for the achievement you open. Toggle under **Interface** or with `/sqol wowhead` (`wh`). Off by default.
- **Show web link** key binding (**Key Bindings > SMoRG's QoL**, no default key) — like Leatrix Plus' binding: pops up a copyable link for what the mouse is over, whether the option is on or not. Items, spells, auras, quests, achievements, currencies, NPCs and battle pets go to Wowhead, players to their armory page (Retail), and anything else to a Wowhead search. Links use each client's Wowhead (`wowhead.com/classic`, `/tbc`, `/mop-classic`, `/forever`) in your client's language.

## [1.4.0] - 2026-10-23

### Added

- **Classic Era, Anniversary and Mists of Pandaria Classic** — the addon now runs in the three Classic clients. The objective and quest completion sounds, colored progress messages, Adventure Recap, the item level/speed line, the reputation features, the ready check countdown, party levels, the damage text font and the cursor highlight all work there, and the item level/speed line sits above the name box like in WoW Forever.
- Features a Classic client can't support are left out of the options window, the Settings page and `/sqol`, and are switched off if they were on: auto-track, Smart Quest Radar, nameplate objective counts and the range icon in all three, and **Hide completed achievements** and the queue pop countdown in Classic Era and Anniversary. The tooltip target line and the XP/reputation colors are offered where the client supports them.

### Fixed

- **WoW Forever:** the range distance for hunters read `< 5 yd` at any range. It now shows the real range at shooting distance, e.g. `8-35 yd`, and out of combat `> 35 yd` with the icon when the target is too far. Far away in combat it can still read `< 5 yd`, because the client reports Raptor Strike in range at any distance and blocks the check that rules it out.
- The range distance also uses the minimum range of the abilities that reach, so a target you can only hit with an 8-yard minimum range ability is shown as at least 8 yards away.

## [1.3.0] - 2026-10-20

### Added

### Added

- **Smart Quest Radar** — a quest icon and up to three unfinished objective counts on one line above the nameplates of units you still need for your quests (e.g. `2/8 · 1/5`), with `+N` for more. It reads the quest lines in the unit's tooltip and only marks a unit when they match your own active, unfinished objectives; your party's progress and data the client keeps hidden are skipped. Replaces the plain nameplate counts while it is on and uses the **Color quest progress** colors. Toggle under **Quests** or with `/sqol radar` (`qr`). Off by default.
- **Adventure Recap** — a movable window with this session's completed quests, world quests, reputation gained, playtime and most active faction, kept per character. `/reload` continues the session, and the previous session stays available with `/sqol recap last`; `reset` starts the current session over and `test` shows sample data. Enable recording under **Quests** and open the window from the options window or with `/sqol recap`. Off by default and never pops up by itself.
- **Reputation Memory** — save a preferred faction per character with `/sqol repfocus` (`status` shows it, `clear` forgets it). With **Auto-watch reputation gains** and **Return to preferred reputation** on, the reputation bar shows a new gain for a moment and goes back to your faction after 10 seconds without new gains. Picking another faction yourself cancels the return, and it is skipped while the Reputation or Collections panel is open. Off by default.
- All new options and messages are translated into every supported client language.

- **Esc → Options → AddOns → SMoRG's QoL** now holds a single button that opens the options window, instead of a second copy of every option, so every route leads to the same window. Right-clicking the LibDataBroker launcher, the minimap button or the addon compartment entry now opens the window too, and the window no longer has a **Blizzard Settings** button.
- The options window is wider, so long labels such as **Quest automation override key** fit, and every section heading has an icon.

## [1.5.0] - 2026-10-27

### Added

- **Colorful unit tooltips** — players' names, specs, the tooltip border and the health bar in their class color (reaction colors for NPCs), the guild in green as `<Guild>`, the level in the difficulty color you know from the target frame, and Horde in red or Alliance in blue, with the health on the health bar (e.g. `18.8K / 23.8K (79%)`). Toggle under **Interface** or with `/sqol tooltipcolor` (`tc`). Off by default.
- **Quest automation** — accepts and turns in quests at quest givers, like Leatrix Plus' *Automate quests*, in every client. Separate options under **Quests** for regular, daily and weekly quests and for turn-ins (`/sqol questaccept`, `questdaily`, `questweekly`, `questturnin`), all off by default. Holding the override key (SHIFT, ALT, CONTROL or CMD, `/sqol questkey`) pauses it; with **Require override key for quest automation** (`/sqol questrequirekey`) quests are only automated while you hold it. Never picks between several rewards, never hands in money, currency or items that aren't quest items, skips quests shared by other players and quests that flag you for PvP, pauses in combat inside instances, and only clicks quest lines in gossip, never gossip options.
- **Wowhead links** — like Leatrix Plus' *Show Wowhead links*: a copyable Wowhead link for the quest in the quest log (on the world map in Retail and WoW Forever, in place of the quest log title in Classic) and for the achievement you open. Toggle under **Interface** or with `/sqol wowhead` (`wh`). Off by default.
- **Show web link** key binding (**Key Bindings > SMoRG's QoL**, no default key) — like Leatrix Plus' binding: pops up a copyable link for what the mouse is over, whether the option is on or not. Items, spells, auras, quests, achievements, currencies, NPCs and battle pets go to Wowhead, players to their armory page (Retail), and anything else to a Wowhead search. Links use each client's Wowhead (`wowhead.com/classic`, `/tbc`, `/mop-classic`, `/forever`) in your client's language.

## [1.4.0] - 2026-10-23

### Added

- **Classic Era, Anniversary and Mists of Pandaria Classic** — the addon now runs in the three Classic clients. The objective and quest completion sounds, colored progress messages, Adventure Recap, the item level/speed line, the reputation features, the ready check countdown, party levels, the damage text font and the cursor highlight all work there, and the item level/speed line sits above the name box like in WoW Forever.
- Features a Classic client can't support are left out of the options window, the Settings page and `/sqol`, and are switched off if they were on: auto-track, Smart Quest Radar, nameplate objective counts and the range icon in all three, and **Hide completed achievements** and the queue pop countdown in Classic Era and Anniversary. The tooltip target line and the XP/reputation colors are offered where the client supports them.

### Fixed

- **WoW Forever:** the range distance for hunters read `< 5 yd` at any range. It now shows the real range at shooting distance, e.g. `8-35 yd`, and out of combat `> 35 yd` with the icon when the target is too far. Far away in combat it can still read `< 5 yd`, because the client reports Raptor Strike in range at any distance and blocks the check that rules it out.
- The range distance also uses the minimum range of the abilities that reach, so a target you can only hit with an 8-yard minimum range ability is shown as at least 8 yards away.

## [1.3.0] - 2026-10-20

### Added

- **Smart Quest Radar** — a quest icon and up to three unfinished objective counts on one line above the nameplates of units you still need for your quests (e.g. `2/8 · 1/5`), with `+N` for more. It reads the quest lines in the unit's tooltip and only marks a unit when they match your own active, unfinished objectives; your party's progress and data the client keeps hidden are skipped. Replaces the plain nameplate counts while it is on and uses the **Color quest progress** colors. Toggle under **Quests** or with `/sqol radar` (`qr`). Off by default.
- **Adventure Recap** — a movable window with this session's completed quests, world quests, reputation gained, playtime and most active faction, kept per character. `/reload` continues the session, and the previous session stays available with `/sqol recap last`; `reset` starts the current session over and `test` shows sample data. Enable recording under **Quests** and open the window from the options window or with `/sqol recap`. Off by default and never pops up by itself.
- **Reputation Memory** — save a preferred faction per character with `/sqol repfocus` (`status` shows it, `clear` forgets it). With **Auto-watch reputation gains** and **Return to preferred reputation** on, the reputation bar shows a new gain for a moment and goes back to your faction after 10 seconds without new gains. Picking another faction yourself cancels the return, and it is skipped while the Reputation or Collections panel is open. Off by default.
- All new options and messages are translated into every supported client language.

### Changed

- **WoW Forever:** the item level/speed line sits above your name like on Retail, right-aligned with the bars, and keeps its place when you change the player frame's size in Edit Mode.
- **WoW Forever:** with **Color XP/reputation numbers** on, the XP and reputation text stays visible. WoW Forever has no setting for it, so it used to show only on mouseover or with the Character window open.

### Fixed

- Auto-watch reputation ignores reputation losses and messages the client keeps hidden, and a faction you discover for the first time no longer counts as a gain.
- Auto-watch no longer rescans over and over when a reputation header changes during a scan, and collapsed headers in the Reputation panel are restored afterwards.

After updating, **restart the game** (a `/reload` is not enough), because this release adds new files.

## [1.2.1] - 2026-10-14

### Changed

- Updated for WoW 12.1.5 (Retail interface `120105`).
- **New addon icon** — a simple quest scroll with a green check replaces the old landscape picture, so the icon is recognizable at the small sizes it is shown in: the AddOns list, the minimap button, the options window and LibDataBroker displays.
- The tooltip for **Custom damage text font** and the options window now say that the font only changes after a game client restart.
